title: Cloud Resources Inventory Info event (cloud asset inventory telemetry for misconfiguration enrichment)
summary: OCSF Cloud Resources Inventory Info events the cloud_misconfiguration playbook consumes at the enrich-resource-and-owner step: the inventory record for the misconfigured resource supplies its type, account and ownership metadata so the finding can be routed to the owning team rather than a shared queue. The class exists upstream from OCSF 1.4.0 (uid 5023); the overlay's original gap note deferred this binding until the catalogue baseline lifted to 1.4.0 — which every artifact under content/telemetry/ now pins. The playbook previously referenced it under the invented name `cloud_resource_inventory`; provenance for the rename is on issue #875.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 Discovery category — Cloud Resources Inventory Info class (uid 5023)
